survey.sub_type_reason: The sheet is dominated by numbered terminal strips, multi-core cable terminations, plug interfaces, a PC/alarm controller card, switch endpoints, indicator/alarm wiring, and interconnected signal/control conductors rather than protective-device schedules or a source-to-bus power one-line.

survey.notes: Single-sheet main-panel control/alarm wiring schematic. Major repeated structures are terminal columns and plug pin banks around one large PC-card/alarm-module enclosure. Explicit multicore cable IDs include MU4-12 and MU5-12. No separate legend is visible. Small terminal numbers and some local annotations are difficult to verify at this image resolution; approximate unit counts are intended only for tiling.
